_meta.description: Audit checklist cho chatbot-fanpage. Moi item = 1 phien run_agent rieng (run_id rieng -> do duoc $/muc). category dung CHUNG voi nhom loi cay Ngay 24 - benchmark va checklist phai cung khung.
_meta.nguon: OWASP Top 10:2025 + kinh nghiem van hanh that (item 11-13 tu su co production cua chinh chu du an)

items.question: Tim secret hardcode trong code .js: grep cac pattern 'EAAG' (page access token Facebook), 'api_key', 'apikey', 'secret', 'password', 'Bearer ' xem co CHUOI LITERAL nao gan thang gia tri that khong. Phan biet ro: doc tu process.env hoac file config ngoai repo = an toan (ghi verified_ok); gan chuoi literal dai/ngau nhien = finding.

Credential hoac PII (token, so dien thoai khach, noi dung tin nhan khach) co bi ghi ra log khong? Grep 'console.log' va 'logger' trong cac file xu ly credential (core/credentials/, core/admin/session.js) va webhook, doc ky xem tham so log co chua token/PII tho khong. He thong co redact truoc khi log khong (goi y: grep 'redact').

He thong co dung thuat toan ma hoa/hash yeu khong? Khao sat mat duong truoc: grep 'createHash|createHmac|createCipher|crypto' ext='.js' xem dang dung gi; roi grep danh sach yeu '\bmd5\b|\bsha1\b|\bdes\b|\brc4\b' ext='.js'. read_file it nhat 1 ham ma hoa chinh de xac nhan.

Cho nao so sanh chu ky/token/secret bang == hoac === thay vi crypto.timingSafeEqual? Grep 'signature|x-hub-signature|safeEqual|timingSafeEqual' ext='.js', read_file cac ham verify tim duoc, soi tung phep so sanh chuoi nhay cam. So sanh not-timing-safe = finding (timing attack).

IV/nonce trong ma hoa AES co bi tai su dung hoac hardcode khong? Grep 'createCipheriv|randomBytes' ext='.js', read_file ham encrypt: IV phai duoc sinh moi bang crypto.randomBytes cho MOI lan ma hoa va luu kem ciphertext. IV hang so/tai dung voi GCM = finding critical (lo keystream).

Co endpoint admin nao thieu kiem tra quyen khong? list_files va read_file core/admin-routes.js (va cac file route admin khac): doi chieu TUNG route voi middleware/ham check quyen (grep 'requirePermission|ROLE_PERMISSIONS|checkAuth'). Route dinh nghia ma khong qua check quyen = finding.

Session/token admin duoc tao va xac thuc the nao? read_file core/admin/session.js: token co ky (HMAC) khong, co thoi han (expiry) khong, verify co check het han khong? Token khong ky hoac khong bao gio het han = finding.

Tai lieu co mo ta SAI ve bao mat so voi code that khong? Grep trong file .md cac tuyen bo ve crypto/auth ('AES|HMAC|encrypt|quyen|role'), chon 2-3 tuyen bo cu the va kiem chung tung cai bang code .js that. Tai lieu noi A code lam B = finding doc-mismatch (evidence_type='doc', kem citation ca 2 phia trong explanation).

read_file package.json: liet ke dependencies + version. Co package nao pinned o major version qua cu hoac co CVE noi tieng da biet khong (vd lodash <4.17.21 prototype pollution, axios <1.6 SSRF...)? Chi bao finding khi BIET CHAC CVE cu the - khong doan mo 'co the cu'; khong chac thi ghi not_checked de nguoi chay 'npm audit' xac nhan.

Du lieu tu webhook (do NGUOI LA gui duoc) co duoc validate truoc khi dung khong? read_file core/webhook.js phan nhan event: truy cap thuoc tinh long (entry[0].messaging[0]...) co optional chaining/guard khong, JSON.parse co try/catch khong, gia tri user dua co di thang vao path/query/eval khong?

Facebook gui LAI webhook event khi khong nhan HTTP 200 kip thoi - he thong co dedup/idempotency de tranh XU LY VA GUI TIN NHAN 2 LAN khong? Grep 'recentMessage|dedup|mid|message_id' ext='.js', read_file co che dedup trong core/webhook.js: no dua tren khoa gi, TTL bao lau, co phu MOI duong gui tin (message, menu, media...) hay chi mot loai? Duong gui nao khong qua dedup = finding. (Nguon: su co production that - tin nhan gui lap 2 lan cho khach.)

Loi tu Facebook Graph API co duoc phan loai xu ly rieng khong? Grep 'error.code|error_subcode|551|\b613\b' ext='.js' va doc nhanh catch: ma 10 (ngoai cua so 24h/thieu permission), 551 (nguoi dung khong kha dung - block/khoa acc), 613 (rate limit) can xu ly KHAC nhau (551 khong duoc retry, 613 phai backoff). Nuot chung moi loi hoac retry mu = finding. (Nguon: su co production that - loi 10/551 voi traffic tu ads.)

App co fail-fast khi thieu bien moi truong bat buoc khong? Grep 'process.env' ext='.js': cac bien quan trong (token, secret, DB path) co duoc validate luc khoi dong (thieu -> throw/exit voi message ro) hay dung truc tiep de undefined troi vao runtime roi chet im lang? Diem danh bien nao co guard, bien nao khong. (Nguon: su co production that - loi env khi deploy Railway.)
